basis: DELTA A. RelateIQ was acquired by Salesforce in July 2014 — a full year before 8VC was founded in the Formation 8 breakup, and before any 8VC vehicle existed to hold it. Formation 8 led its 2013 Series B. It appears only on the June-2016 capture of 8vc.com/companies and is gone from the live site. Recommended ruling: a legacy row is a member only where an 8VC vehicle took a position, and none could have. Erik's confirmation is pending; the row is flagged so a reversal re-judges the class rather than re-collecting it.
DELTA A. SalesforceIQ is RelateIQ under its post-acquisition name; same position, same reasoning, and a duplicate of the relateiq row.

DELTA A. Oculus VR was acquired by Facebook in March 2014 for ~$2B, sixteen months before 8VC existed; Formation 8 was not on its cap table either, so the listing reflects a partner's earlier involvement rather than a fund position. On the June-2016 capture only.

DELTA A, and the firm's own words decide it: 'we co-led the angel round in 2010, led the Series A in 2012, bridged the company after the A and co-led the Series B' (8vc.com, 2020-12-17). The 2010 angel round predates Formation 8 (2011) and 8VC (2015) — it is Joe Lonsdale's personal money, which T2 puts out. 8VC GP I's 13F-HRs report one holding, Joby Aviation, not ContextLogic.

DELTA A. Oscar Health's legal entity Mulberry Health Inc. filed a $134.9M Form D in 2015q2 carrying Joe Lonsdale — before 8VC existed and outside his 8VC tenure window; Formation 8 led Oscar's earlier rounds. Oscar has been public (NYSE: OSCR) since March 2021 and no 8VC vehicle reports a position. Lonsdale's own 2016 8VC bio lists Oscar among HIS board seats.

DELTA A. Mulberry Health Inc. is Oscar Health's legal entity and follows the oscar row's ruling; the 2015q2 filing that created this row is itself the Formation 8-era evidence. Supersedes this run's earlier member verdict on the same row, which deferred the ruling rather than making it.

DELTA A. Press dates the position to FORMATION 8, at Guardant Health's February-2015 $50M Series C led by Lightspeed — before 8VC existed. Guardant has been public (NASDAQ: GH) since October 2018 and no 8VC vehicle appears on any filing.

DELTA A. Illumio's institutional investors through the 2013-2014 rounds are recorded as Andreessen Horowitz, General Catalyst, FORMATION 8 and Data Collective — the position predates 8VC. Lonsdale's own 2016 8VC bio lists Illumio among HIS board seats, and no 8VC vehicle appears on any Illumio filing.

DELTA A. OpenGov was co-founded by Joe Lonsdale in 2012 and backed by Formation 8; Cox Enterprises took a majority stake in 2024. Lonsdale's own 2016 8VC bio lists OpenGov among HIS board seats, its CEO Zachary Bookman is on 8VC's own ADVISORS page, and no 8VC vehicle appears on any OpenGov filing. Neither a founder seat nor an advisor seat is fund money (T2, T4).

DELTA A. Color Genomics launched in 2015 with a Series A backed by Khosla Ventures and FORMATION 8, before 8VC existed; the row is on the June-2016 capture as 'color-genomics'. No 8VC vehicle appears on any Color filing, and the company remains private so no 13F would show one either — the evidence is the era plus the predecessor's documented participation.
